text: What our brand community actually does. So customers still belonging to something better than the product. Members answer each other's questions before you have to. Word of mouth spreads without you orchestrating it. Cancellations drop because leaving feels like believing a group. Customer feedback flows directly to product development. Your most loyal customers recruit new ones organically. Most people that they use for community can either be Facebook groups or Discord. It really depends. I would prefer having a Facebook group with real clients. So customers that bought from us and then on Discord, I would build a community of like royal influencers, affiliates and then incentivize them in order to keep promoting our product, gifting them free gifts, create tiers for that. And I'm obviously skating it that way.
